name: Infantry_News
author: Infantry AI
description: News headlines for every agent: the news.headlines capability (Google News RSS, no key: top stories, a topic, a search or one source), the card:news chat card (headline cards with source, time, thumbnail or source icon, and a link) and the News Agent role. Nothing is saved. Any agent may use the capability and the card while this plugin is loaded; without it a card:news block shows as code.

cards.summary: News headlines: a list of headline cards (title, source, relative time, thumbnail or source icon, link)
cards.spec:
News card (Infantry_News): a list of headline cards.

Easiest: call the capability news.headlines (infantry_capability_call, capability "news.headlines", args {"query"?, "topic"?, "source"?, "max"?}) and paste its `card` field as is: it is the finished fenced block.

By hand: its own fenced block, info string `card:news`, body ONE JSON object:

```card:news
{"title": "Top stories", "items": [{"title": "Headline text", "source": "Reuters", "url": "https://...", "time": "2026-11-12T09:30:00Z", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/...", "icon": "https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=reuters.com&sz=64"}]}
```

Fields: `title` (heading above the list, optional); `items[]` with `title` and `url` (https) required, `source`, `time` (ISO-8601, shown as "2h ago"), `image` (thumbnail; any https image host, fetched by the daemon), `icon` (source icon). Missing image: the source icon, else a letter badge. Never invent items: use only what news.headlines returned. Keep one plain sentence outside the block.

roles.name: News Agent
roles.description: Fetches the news you ask for (top stories, a topic, a search, one source) and answers with headline cards.
roles.persona:
You are the News Agent, a role brought by the Infantry_News plugin. You fetch news the user asks for and show it as headline cards.

For every news request:
1. Call the capability news.headlines through infantry_capability_call (CLI: `infantry tool call infantry_capability_call --payload '{"capability":"news.headlines","args":{...}}'`). Args: `query` (free text search), `topic` (world, nation, business, technology, entertainment, sports, science, health, or any other words), `source` (a site like reuters.com or a name), `max` (how many, default 6). No args = the top stories.
2. Answer with ONE plain sentence, then the result's `card` field pasted exactly as it is (a ```card:news fenced block). Do not rewrite, reorder or invent headlines; do not repeat them as a list.
3. If the call fails or returns no items, say so in one plain sentence and suggest a broader query.

Nothing is saved between requests; fetch fresh each time.

capabilities.description: Current news headlines from Google News (no key): top stories with no args, a topic section (world, nation, business, technology, entertainment, sports, science, health), a free-text query, or one source (site:domain). Answers {title, feed, count, card}; `card` is a finished ```card:news block to paste into the reply as is.

topic.description: A topic: world, nation, business, technology, entertainment, sports, science, health (a section feed), or any other words (searched).

source.description: One source: a domain (reuters.com, searched as site:reuters.com) or a name.

max.description: How many headlines (default the news.items setting, 6; at most limits.news.maxItems).

config.title: News headlines
config.applies: Applies to: the news.headlines capability (every agent, the News Agent role).

fields.label: Headlines per answer (when the agent does not say)
Language (Google News hl, e.g. en-US, en-GB, de)
Country edition (Google News gl, e.g. US, GB, DE)
Show each source's site icon when a headline has no thumbnail (one cached image fetch per source)
Reuse a fetched feed for (minutes, 0 = always fetch)
